headline: Changes to approved Overlook Ridge housing plans at Rowe's Quarry, Lots 14B and 13B, including unit counts and parking.
summary: Overlook Ridge LLC asks to change its approved site plan for Lot 14B, cutting homeownership units from eighty-two (82) to fifty-one (51). The request also covers a proposed five-story building with ninety-nine (99) age-restricted senior rental units on Lot 13B, and changes to eight site plan conditions.
items: Lot 14B: change homeownership units from eighty-two (82) to fifty-one (51)
Lot 14B: change building height from five stories to four stories
Lot 14B: change onsite parking from 144 spaces to 73 spaces
Lot 14B: amend Condition 1.B (Plans) and Condition 2.B (Project Description)
Lot 13B: construct five-story building with ninety-nine (99) age-restricted senior rental units
Lots 13B and 14B: amend Condition 3 on compliance with Special Permit conditions
Lots 13B and 14B: amend Condition 8 on the Land Reclamation Agreement
Lots 13B and 14B: amend Condition 13 on Joint Fire Station Second Entrance
Lots 13B and 14B: amend Condition 14 on speed mitigation and traffic calming on Overlook Ridge Drive
Lots 13B and 14B: amend Condition 15 on Route One Southbound Ramps traffic analysis
Lots 13B and 14B: amend Condition 17 on garage screening
Lots 13B and 14B: amend Condition 20 on the site plan approval expiration date
Lots 13B and 14B: amend Condition 21 on non-assignability and non-transferability
location: Conference Room 105, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA
plain_text:
ROWE’S QUARRY SITE PLAN REVIEW COMMITTEE 
 
PUBLIC PROJECT REVIEW MEETING 
 
The Rowe’s Quarry Site Plan Review Committee will hold a public project review meeting in Malden 
City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA, in Conference Room 105, at 6:00 P.M. on Monday, 
November 23, 2026, to review the applications of WinnDevelopment Company LP, made on behalf of 
Overlook Ridge LLC, seeking to amend the Site Plan Approval granted on January 22, 2025 (letter dated 
January 30, 2025), under Title 12, Chapter 28, Section 140 of the Code of the City of Malden, for 
development in the Rowe’s Quarry Reclamation & Redevelopment District, Subdistrict RQ3,  at the 
property known as Lot 14B and by City Assessor’s Parcel ID #185 575 513 and the property known as Lot 
13B and by City Assessor’s Parcel ID #185 575 511, namely, to amend the Site Plan Approval as follows: 
1. Regarding Permit Application # CMID-068998-2024 for Lot 14B, to modify the proposal to 
construct a building for multifamily residential dwelling use, namely, to change the number of 
homeownership units from eighty-two (82) units to fifty-one (51) units; to change the height from five 
stories to four stories; to change the number of onsite parking spaces from 144 spaces to 73 spaces ; and to 
amend Condition 1.B regarding Plans and Condition 2.B regarding Project Description; and  
2.   Regarding the above-referenced Permit Application # CMID-068998-2024 for Lot 14B; and 
regarding Permit Application # CMID-068997-2024 for Lot 13B, the proposal to construct a building for 
multifamily residential dwelling use, with five stories and ninety-nine (99) age-restricted senior rental units, 
to amend the following conditions of the Site Plan Approval applicable to both proposals:   
Condition 3 regarding compliance with Special Permit conditions;  
Condition 8 regarding the Land Reclamation Agreement;  
Condition 13 regarding Joint Fire Station Second Entrance;  
Condition 14 regarding Speed Mitigation/Traffic Calming on Overlook Ridge Drive;  
Condition 15 regarding Route One Southbound Ramps Traffic Analysis;  
Condition 17 regarding Garage Screening;  
Condition 20 regarding Site Plan Approval Expiration Date; and  
Condition 21 regarding Non-Assignability/Non-Transferability.   
Applications and plans are available for public review in the Inspectional Services Department, Malden 
City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Room 330, Malden, and City website under Permit Applications ## CMID-
068998-2024 and CMID-068997-2024 at https://maldenma-energovweb.tylerhost.net/apps/SelfService#/search 
 
By: Michelle A. Romero 
City Planner
